title: Frontier exploration A: three null results and twelve killed ideas
question: Frontier A (ECDLP-28) tested hypotheses, all NULL at toy sizes: (F-A1) the second p-adic digit of the homomorphic Hensel section E(F_p) -> E(Z/p^2) along [k]P has random-like linear complexity (BM L/n = 0.500) and no P-recursive relation of order/degree <= 3; (F-A2) x(jP) is not an approximate Freiman homomorphism (additive/multiplicative coincidences |z| <= 1.3 vs permutation null, p ~ 2^20); (F-A3) the ECDLP energy landscape behaves as a random energy model; annealing underperforms random sampling. 12 further ideas killed with one-line reasons (incl. tropical, L-function, isogeny-walk, halving, expander, Pollard–Strassen).
